in_sanskrit.name: Bandhura
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Bound, Tied, Attached
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bandhura एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Sanskrit, Bandhura means 'bound,' 'tied,' or 'attached.' It is derived from the root 'bandh,' which means 'to tie.' In Hindu mythology, Bandhura is the name of a divine entity, often depicted as a female figure representing attachment, love, and devotion.
